{{tocright}}[[File:Mercenary_Faction_Building.png|left]]
{{Description|"When a mercenary crosses your path, there's only one thing that can save your life: offer him more money than he can get by killing you. If you gain the favor of the mercenaries, you will be able to combine the power of all races at once."}}

==The Mercenary Faction ==
[[File:Mecenary champion trophy.png|left|Mercenary Champion Trophy]]
The Mercenaries were implemented in the [[Updates#1.3 Afterlife|After Life]] expansion (v1.3), and differ from the other factions: Unlocked at R3, they are available in all [[alignments]], and can combine the power of all the other unlocked [[factions]] by letting you choose 2 [[spells]] and 3x4 [[Faction Upgrades|faction upgrades]]. This enables you to create powerful cross-faction [[Merc Builds|mercenary builds]]. However, this comes with the downside of high Faction Coin requirements, and initial gem requirement to reach E55 coins with unbonused alignment buildings only.

{| style="float:right; clear:right;"
|[[File:Mercerairy spell choice.png|thumb|177x177px|Spell Selection]]
|[[File:Merc-spell-choice1.png|thumb|177x177px|Upgrade selection]]
|}
* '''[[Alignment]]''': '''Any'''
* '''[[Spells|Faction Spell]]''': '''Custom''' (depending on alignment<ref name=":0">The ''Hellfire Blast'' and ''Lighting Strike'' spells are based on [[aligned buildings]]. As such, they are only available when you have those buildings. Same goes for upgrades based on aligned items.</ref>)  
* '''[[Spells#Spell Upgrades|Spell Upgrade]]''': see [[#Other Upgrades|below]]
* '''[[Heritage]]''':  Increase the production of all buildings based on the highest amount of coins you gained in a single game.<br />{{Formula|stat|floor(5 * log(1 + x))|Coins Gained (Max)}}
* '''[[Bloodline]]''': None - See [[Bloodline#Bloodstream|Bloodstream]]  
* '''[[Challenge]]''': None  
* '''[[Unique Building]]s''':  ''Good:'' Mercenary Camp (from Knights Jousts)<br />''Evil:'' Tyrant Garrison - (from Evil Fortresses)<br />''Neutral:'' Freemason's Hall - (from Alchemist Labs)  
* '''[[Research]]''': R75  
* '''Faction Unlock Requirements''': R3+ see [[#Unlock Requirements|below]]

== Mercenary Tier Upgrades ==
The Tier upgrades enable to choose from the all the existing [[faction upgrades]]. These cost coins and [[Faction Coins]]. The FC type necessary depends on your selection: For a Fairy upgrade, it will cost Fairy coins; for Elven upgrade, it will cost Elven coins; and so forth.

== Unlock Requirements ==
Unlocking the Mercenaries requires the third reincarnation, the following can be unlocked in different abdications.
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%" id="Unlock Requirements"
! colspan="4" |Mercenary Unlock Requirements
|-
! colspan="2" |Name
!Cost
!Description
|-
![[File:MercTribute.png]]
!Mercenary Tribute
|At least (minimum):
* {{Number|1 Nod}} Coins
* 100,000 of each [[Faction Coins|Faction Coin]]
(Price increases with time, but is reset at [[Abdications]].)
| style="width:50%;" |''Pay the mercenaries a tribute to unlock their powers. Be quick though, the price increases over time!''
|-
![[File:MercOath.png]]
!Mercenary Oath
|{{Number|1 Tvg}} Coins.
| style="width:50%;" |''By reciting the Oath of the Mercenaries you will be able to join mercenaries for the rest of your existence. Not even Reincarnations will strip you of this right. You will be able to take any alignment and become a Good, Neutral or Evil mercenary, therefore determining your building set, and from there on you will be able to take any spell or ability from any other faction.''
|}
<u>'''Unlocking The Mercenaries:'''</u><br />
The cost of the "''Mercenary Tribute"'' rises very quickly and gets reset at abdications. Aim for a run where you can quickly gain enough [[Faction Coins|FCs]] to buy it before it gets too expensive. Do it when you have enough gems to afford ~100 or more [[excavations]]. Suggested faction to do this is [[Titans]] with at least {{Number|1 No}} gems - ''<u>and make [[Save Tab|save files]]</u> before in case you want to start over and get your excavations back.''

<blockquote style="font-size:99%">''Coin'' {{Formula|stat|1e60 * (ceil (1+x)/60))^{3.5}|playtime|seconds}}<br />
''FC'' {{Formula|stat|100000 * (ceil((1 + x)/60))^{0.5}|playtime|seconds}}</blockquote>

[[File:MercUnlockMsg-s.png|300px|right]]
Once it is purchased, you have unlocked the mercenaries and their trade treaty, the "''Mercenary First Contact"'', will show up in all your future games, alongside other Faction Trade Treaties of the same alignment.

See also "[http://www.kongregate.com/forums/8945-realm-grinder/topics/547245#posts-9738076 Unlocking Mercenaries]" in why_amihere's guide.

Joining the Mercenaries for the first time will grant the ''Mercenary Oath'' [[Trophies#Secret Trophies|Secret Trophy]]. (You will need at least {{Number|1 No}} gems to do this, and to not join any other faction!)
{{clr}}

At R75, the buildings can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]] depending on your chosen alignment, which are required for some research quests and upgrades.
*'''Good:''' Mercenary Camp - Upgraded from Knights Jousts
*'''Evil:''' Tyrant Garrison - Upgraded from Evil Fortresses
*'''Neutral:''' Freemason's Hall - Upgraded from Inns{{clr}}

== Mercenary Research ==
Upon reaching R75, the game advisor tells us that the Mercenary Lord himself has come to speak with you. 

''"He is a man of uncomparable strength and influence... From what I heard, he wishes to task you with the retrieval of an Obsidian Shard, the legendary material of which Mercenary Blades are made."''

To gain access to Mercenary research, you will need the ''Secrets of the Warriors'' upgrade. This upgrade will appear once you have bought a unique Mercenary building and found the ''Obsidian Shard'' artifact.
